name: Rowan Fujiwara

physical_description.heritage: Balanced quadratic ancestry creating a striking pan-Asian-Latin phenotype: South Asian (33.7%) and East Asian (33.4%) form the dominant genetic foundation with characteristic high cheekbones, defined eye geometry, and strong facial structure. Northern European ancestry (10.0%) contributes subtle cool undertones, increased bone density in the jaw, and lighter undertones in skin that prevent the complexion from appearing overly saturated. The result is a sophisticated blended phenotype where East Asian eye shape meets South Asian cheekbone prominence, tempered by Latin warmth and cooled by Northern European undertones—a man whose face tells the story of global diaspora.

Medium-deep in neutral light, deepening to rich caramel-amber in warm illumination, maintaining consistent olive-golden undertones year-round. Appears slightly darker on the neck and forearms from sun exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but maintained — clean-shaven jaw with subtle scarring along the left jawline from old trauma. Crow's feet suggest frequent squinting or chronic stress. High cheekbones with pronounced South/East Asian prominence softened by Latin facial structure. Skin texture is weathered but not neglected; faint chemical scars on knuckles suggest deliberate removal of identifying marks. Subtle sun-damage patterns on temples.

Handshake is firm but controlled. Speaks quietly, forcing others to lean in; listens more than talks. Eyes track fast movement on instinct.
